annotations.title: Browse the index by kind or source

description: Browse the StealthStack index without a search query: for example every agent skill (kind=skill), everything one domain publishes (domain=...), or services that accept x402 payments (paid=x402). Returns the total, a count per kind and one page of records with connect details. For a specific need ("MCP server for Postgres") use search_resources, which ranks by relevance.

domain.description: Optional. Only resources from this source domain, e.g. "stealthstack.ai".

kind.description: Optional. Only one kind: mcp (MCP server), skill (agent skill, SKILL.md), agent (A2A agent), api (HTTP / OpenAPI service), catalog or registry (lists of more resources), other. Omit to include every kind.

paid.description: Optional. x402 = only services that list x402 pay-per-request pricing (stablecoins). A filter, not a ranking.

trust.description: Optional. verified = the record's URN names the same domain that hosts its catalog. It shows where the record was published, not that anyone reviewed the resource.

name: list_resources

access.description: What is known about auth and pricing. requiresAuth comes from the MCP Registry entry; auth and pricing are StealthStack's automated labels (unknown values omitted).

connect.description: How to reach the resource. mode=url: `url`; mode=connections: `connections[]` (stdio → command/args, http/sse/streamable-http → url); mode=pull: `pull.command` (e.g. dirctl pull <cid>); mode=data: inline artifact of unrecognised shape (`dataKeys`; `data` itself when small, get_resource only); mode=none: nothing published.

install.description: Packages to install the server from (MCP Registry entries). `command` is a ready-to-run start command (npx / uvx / docker / cargo), present only when the package name passes a strict charset check.

env.description: Required environment variable names the package lists (names only).

versionRejected.description: The listed version failed validation; `command` is not pinned to it.

payment.description: Payment terms the service lists (x402): protocol, lowest listed price + currency, network (CAIP-2). Self-declared; never a payee address.

score.description: Relevance as returned by the index /search (search_resources only).

title: Browse the index by kind or source
